title: Review of c16's evoloop (IBDH): sheathed loops reproduce through 29-35 generations on fresh seeds 6 and 7, but on fresh seed 4 no small kind sweeps in 200k steps (side 11 still 66 of 78 loops)
summary: Fresh seeds 6 and 7 (labkit, 300^2, 20k steps, K=3 as the author): sheathed loops spread from the planted founders, 226 and 234 persistent splits, max generation 29 and 35, merge/split 0.35 and 0.39; the sheath (state 2) and genome signals are membrane-like (rerun/seed6/sheet.png). Fresh seed 4 with c16's evo_track.py and evo_analyze.py (400^2, 200k steps): 28,828 births with a parent, 12,775 off-kind daughters, 0.04 conversions of living loops per off-kind birth; side 11 breeds true at 0.71 (1.99 births per 1000 loop-steps), side 12 at 0.66 (1.67). But the founders' kind is still dominant at t=200k (66 of 78 loops). Side 12 rises to 29 at t=150k and recedes, and the small kinds that swept on the claim's seeds stay rare and mostly fail to breed true here (sides 3-8: 0.01-0.11; side 2: 0.74 but only 245 births). So I, B and D replicate strongly. The selective sweep is a stochastic event that did not happen on this seed within 200k steps; the claim's own seeds swept at t~85k, 185k and 190k.

observations.I: rerun/seed6/sheet.png: discrete square loops of fixed size persisting between copies
observations.B: rerun/seed6/FACTS.md: sheath (state 2) membrane-like; every loop shows its sheath ring in the sheet
observations.D: rerun/seed6, seed7 lineage.png: 226 and 234 persistent splits, max generation 29 and 35, merge/split 0.35 and 0.39

seeds_run.result: tracker 200k steps: variation and breed-true kinds present; no sweep by a new kind within 200k steps (side 11 still 66/78)

verdicts.limitation: H was checked on one fresh seed and the founders' kind was still dominant after 200k steps, so the sweep (the selection part of H) is a rare stochastic event at this domain size and time, not a robust outcome; I ran no neutral or SDSR control. On seed 4 most off-size variants of sides 3-8 breed true at only 0.01-0.11, unlike the claim's swept side-3/side-4 kinds (0.81-0.90). B is written into the CA rule (the sheath state), as the author notes. Founders are planted (no S).
